```lean
intro n
have h0 : 0 ∈ interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ) := h
let f := ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ
let g := fun x => X x
let h' : ∀ n, iteratedDeriv n f 0 = ∫ (x : Ω), (X ^ n) x ∂μ :=
  by induction n with n IH
  · simp [iteratedDeriv, f, g, integrableExpSet, measurableSet_Union, measurableSet_borel]
    erw [integral_zero, zero_pow]
  · rw [iteratedDeriv, IH, iteratedDeriv, IH, iteratedDeriv, IH]
    erw [integral_mul_left, integral_pow]
    exact (h0).mp (by simp)
```
